gloss: mixed hot pot; assorted ingredients cooked in broth

definitions.gloss: mixed hot pot; assorted ingredients cooked in broth
definitions.explanation: A hot pot dish where various ingredients such as seafood, meat, tofu, and vegetables are simmered together in broth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今夜|こんや}→今夜：01411_konya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{寄|よ}せ{鍋|なべ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Let's have mixed hot pot tonight.

examples.japanese: {寄|よ}せ{鍋|なべ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧な⟦{具材|ぐざい}→具材：06230_guzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I put my favorite ingredients in the hot pot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{寄|よ}せ{鍋|なべ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{囲|かこ}む→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧だ。
examples.english: On cold days, there's nothing better than gathering around a mixed hot pot together.

notes:
A type of ⟦{鍋|なべ}{料理|りょうり}→鍋料理：19952_naberyouri⟧ (hot pot dish) where various ingredients — typically seafood, meat, tofu, and vegetables — are simmered together in a dashi-based broth. The name comes from ⟦{寄|よ}せる→寄せる：02329_yoseru⟧ (to bring together), reflecting the mix of assorted ingredients.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寄|よ}せ{鍋|なべ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make mixed hot pot
- {寄|よ}せ{鍋|なべ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{具材|ぐざい}→具材：06230_guzai⟧: hot pot ingredients
- {寄|よ}せ{鍋|なべ}⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧: hot pot ingredient set (sold at supermarkets)

CULTURAL NOTE:
A quintessential winter dish in Japan. Unlike specialized hot pots like ⟦すき{焼|や}き→すき焼き：10368_sukiyaki⟧ or ⟦しゃぶしゃぶ→しゃぶしゃぶ：10479_shabushabu⟧, {寄|よ}せ{鍋|なべ} has no fixed recipe — families use whatever ingredients they like. It is commonly eaten as a communal meal, with everyone sharing from the same pot.
